name: io.github.SkyPorch/daykeeper-mcp
title: Daykeeper MCP
description: A local stdio MCP adapter for the Daykeeper management API.

environmentVariables.name: DAYKEEPER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Daykeeper management API base URL; use HTTPS in production.

environmentVariables.name: DAYKEEPER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scoped headless credential. Set this or DAYKEEPER_ACCESS_TOKEN, but not both.

environmentVariables.name: DAYKEEPER_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Short-lived OAuth access token. Set this or DAYKEEPER_API_KEY, but not both.
